title: geum rivale var. subalpinum
intro: Geum rivale var. subalpinum, commonly known as the Alpine Avens, is a variant of the Geum rivale plant species, which is a type of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Geum rivale var. subalpinum include its ability to act as a vulnerary, helping to promote wound healing, and as a demulcent, providing a soothing and protective effect on mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
